tools.description: Run a bash shell command in the project directory and return its stdout and stderr.
tools.name: bash

timeout_seconds.description: Optional per-call timeout override in seconds (wins over the configured default; without it the configured default applies, unbounded when none is set)

tools.description: Edit an existing file by replacing an exact substring (byte-for-byte, no patterns). Prefer this over shell commands (`sed -i`, `python3` heredocs) for changing files: it reports the match count and line numbers, and fails loudly instead of silently editing the wrong place. Call it several times in one round to make several edits. `old_string` must be unique: include a few lines of surrounding context, or pass `replace_all`.
tools.name: edit

old_string.description: The exact text to replace (must match the file byte-for-byte)

path.description: The file to edit (relative paths resolve against the working directory)

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of failing on multiple matches (default: false)

tools.description: Read an image file from disk and attach it so you can see it.
tools.name: view-image

path.description: The image file to view (relative paths resolve against the working directory)
